title: A DOM form on a quad in a Godot 4 scene
blurb: A Godot 4.7 web export whose central quad shows a real login form and chat box. The browser paints the form into Godot's own WebGL texture and handles typing, focus and taps where Godot drew it.
question: Can a Godot 4 web export show a live DOM form on a quad in a 3D scene, with the browser handling typing, focus and clicks on the real fields where Godot drew them?
result: Yes in headless Chromium 157, with a stock Godot 4.7.2 export, one GDScript file and a JavaScript bridge. Three routes to the texture were built and all three draw the form. Not run on a phone.
